name: Clock
behavior: CONTROL pulse oscillator, not host transport or MIDI/event clock. Frequency=BPM/60*integerTicksPerBeat.
Round Ticks per beat to nearest integer (ties upward), latch live selector per event; Run>=.5 starts, otherwise exact output0 and freeze phase. Do not smooth discrete selectors or reset edges.
Initial/reset phase0; reset input rising edge >=.5 sets phase0, held reset does not retrigger. Reset preserves knob targets and clears reset-edge memory.
At phase0 running output1, while phase<Duty output1 else0; advance phase after output each sample with bounded wrap. BPM uses shared5ms ramp; Duty immediate threshold.
Host graph reset phase0, no wall clock and no global tempo singleton; pulse width/sample quantization documented.
acceptance: 120BPM, one tick and duty.5: 2Hz pulse sequence and exact edge counts at 48k.
